svg.title: All-In Startup Stack for One Corporate Housing Unit
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-07-corporate-unit-startup-stack; chapter number: 4; chart type: stacked_comparison; title: All-In Startup Stack for One Corporate Housing Unit; subtitle: Rent, deposit, and furniture against monthly payback; caption: Dr Chau Ong's startup math for one subleased mid-term corporate unit, recouped in about 6 months at $2k a month.; assumptions note: Single-unit figures from one operator; low and high are equal because one value was reported per bucket. The payback bucket is monthly cash flow, not an upfront cost.; note: Dr Chau Ong via Landlord Diaries - The Monthly Rentals Podcast (yo5DDACarw0); demand-first gate from Jorge Garcia | Roadmap Lodging (Ewazlh6zOLM).; total range: $12,000 all-in, recouped in about 6 months at $2k/month; buckets: label: First month rent; low: 2500; high: 2500; notes: Subleased mid-term unit; label: Security deposit; low: 2500; high: 2500; notes: Paid at lease signing; label: Furniture; low: 7000; high: 7000; notes: Largest single bucket; label: Monthly cash flow toward payback; low: 2000; high: 2000; notes: Lock a relocation, adjuster, or HR relationship before the lease
